extras.agent_focus: Systematic sweep of ~50 Dataverse/DSpace/Invenio academic repositories to find which accept an outsider with a plain email address, plus what their caps actually are. Identity gate treated as the primary ranking field. Probe method: GET /api/dataverses/1/storage/quota?showInherited=true on every Dataverse instance (numeric root id works where alias 'root' 404s), GET /api/info/version for liveness, /api/dataverses/1 for effectiveDatasetFileCountLimit.
